Each expanded module connects biological measurements to method choices, assumptions, worked R examples and interpretation challenges, with suggested answers and selected further reading. Follow a course pathway in the [unified map](course_map.qmd), or choose a block below.

## Available modules

- [B01: Biological questions and omics measurements](notes/b01_foundations.qmd)
- [B02: Experimental design and biological sampling](notes/b02_design.qmd)
- [B03: Biological databases and identifier mapping](notes/b03_databases.qmd)
- [B04: Programming and reproducible data handling](notes/b04_programming.qmd)
- [B05: Genomic measurements and sequence analysis](notes/b05_genomics.qmd)
- [B06: Transcriptomics and expression analysis](notes/b06_transcriptomics.qmd)
- [B07: Epigenomic measurements and regulatory interpretation](notes/b07_epigenomics.qmd)
- [B08: Protein identification, abundance and structure](notes/b08_proteomics.qmd)
- [B09: Metabolite features, identification and quantification](notes/b09_metabolomics.qmd)
- [B10: Microbial communities and host relationships](notes/b10_microbiomics.qmd)
- [B11: Phenomics, sensors and measurement timing](notes/b11_phenomics.qmd)
- [B12: Statistical models and honest validation](notes/b12_statistics.qmd)
- [B13: Association, prediction and regulatory evidence](notes/b13_association.qmd)
- [B14: Pathway enrichment and biological networks](notes/b14_networks.qmd)
- [B15: Integrating molecular layers and phenotypes](notes/b15_integration.qmd)
- [B16: Single-cell, spatial and emerging methods](notes/b16_advanced.qmd)
- [B17: Reproducibility, data governance and responsible research](notes/b17_integrity.qmd)
- [B18: Animal-production questions and integrated reporting](notes/b18_synthesis.qmd)

## Development status

All 18 modules are available. Each is linked to suitable practicals; advanced topics are identified as conceptual extensions where a specialized software pipeline is not implemented.
